jobs_results.title: Senior Program Manager (Program and Delivery Mngt Office Team)
jobs_results.description:
Hi there!
We are Semrush, a global IT company developing our own product—a platform for digital marketers. New stars are born here, so don’t miss your chance.
This is our Senior Program Manager (Program and Delivery Mngt Office Team) role for those who strive to implement functional processes and drive them to full completion.

Tasks in the role
• Develop a comprehensive program plan for each acquisition or initiative, including deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies.
• Synchronize and coordinate activities across a core team of business stakeholders (Finance, HR, Corporate Development, Product, IT, Security, and Commercialization teams) to ensure completion of all workstream deliverables once an acquisition has been initiated.
• Develop and be the owner of a coordinated approach for managing activities across simultaneous acquisitions at different stages.
• Serve as the ‘communication hub’ to ensure effective communication and coordination across stakeholder groups.
• Provide... effective and regular progress updates (written and verbal) for senior leaders and partners throughout the process.
• Deliver plans and assignments of detailed action plans to drive integrations of the overall acquisition pre and post-close.
• Proactively identify areas of risk and leverage effective risk management processes to propose solutions and drive closure.
• Develop a consistent framework that will be followed for acquisition integration activities, including structure and communication channels for the executive steering committee and working teams.
• Identify process gaps and work cross-functionally to develop and improve processes.
• Develop and drive project plans for post-merger integration activities for prior acquisitions that were not fully integrated with the current operating model

jobs_results.title: R&D Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
The era of software-defined vehicles has already arrived, and mobility industry is using software to drive innovation and create new business models and deliver more services to end consumers. To accelerate this vision, disruptor mobility tech companies like Technica are leading the changes in the electronics architecture that are needed by the industry, with our ability to deliver rapid prototyping hardware and software, being more critical than ever.

To develop this vision, we @Technica-Engineering built four years ago a completely new engineering team located in Barcelona area, which is working closely in contact with our company headquarters in Munich.

Technica is a product-oriented company, that continuously reinvest to stay ahead of the curve, so our interdisciplinary team composed by hardware and software experts is focused on the development of company own products roadmap and on innovative R&D electronics development projects with major customers.

Therefore, if you are an... enthusiastic professional interested in being part of a fast-growing company with strong engineering and research culture, we are looking for a passionate Project Leader / Manager for R&D projects to join the team and help us.

“The ideal candidate has a background in programming, networking and electronics and has already experience in the daily tasks related with the management of research projects.”

MAIN FUNCTIONS
• Collaborate with management board and engineering team leaders to identify know-how expansion opportunities through research investments, and to clearly define related activities, aligning them with objectives defined on vertical markets of interest.
• Participate in initial definition of the innovation and research projects, internally in collaboration with the different technical groups and externally aligning with the potential collaborating partners.
• Participate in the budget elaboration and coordination of the different teams that need to be aligned during the presentation of proposals.
• Lead a cross-functional team of developers to successfully execute R&D projects at both European and national levels, ensuring adherence to planned budget allocation, achievement of project objectives and roadmap within designated timelines, and guaranteeing the quality of deliverables.
• Work closely with the technical team in the review of planned implementation, validation of results and elaboration of technical deliverables.
• Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through rigorous investigation and continuous self-learning, ensuring the identification of potential new projects and aligning current project work items with their appropriate scopes.
• Implement risk management strategies for those projects, elaborating plans to mitigate risks and establishing contingency plans for effective control.
• Define and coordinate project communication strategy as well as dissemination activities in the scope of those projects.
• Lead the project meetings during the execution of the project either between the different technical/business teams and with outside collaborators/partners.
• Represent Technica at consortium events in collaborative projects at EU or national level.
• Generate accurate periodic reporting of progress and blocking points, to be able to communicate efficiently with the internal team and our partners.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full flexibility to manage hybrid work model, depending on the tasks.
• Attractive professional career development close to different areas related to electronics development, software development, in-vehicle networking technologies / protocols and web applications / cloud platforms to support our projects and products.
• Company culture oriented to research engineering with no politics and a clear reinvestment mindset in research. Company made by engineers and managed by engineers.
• Opportunity to be introduced in automotive market within a company working as pure R&D partner for main European OEMs.
• High diversity of state-of-the-art projects with technologies 3-4 years beyond what is currently in series production vehicles.
• Opportunity to work in an international environment within a diverse team. International mobility options available to discuss case-by-case.
• 30 working days as holidays, with full flexibility to manage them.
• Private health insurance.
• Regular team building activities with specific company budget.
• Opportunity to further expand your training, from personal abilities to technical areas.

For additional information in case you want to know more about us, check our website: https://technica-engineering.de/en/

SKILLS
• Previous professional experience in project management roles on automotive, telecommunications or software development industry. Automotive is not a must.
• Strong engineering background (preferably telecommunications or computer science) and desirable previous experience on development roles before switching to project management.
• Continuous learning mindset in a technological context combined with executive synthesis skills, to quickly get a grasp on any new technological concept without needing to know deeply all details.
• Strong analytical and investigation skills to work in research projects with new technologies in early design phases.
• Good knowledge and application of agile methodologies.
• Good know-how of tools for project management using agile methodologies (for example Trello, JIRA, Confluence, etc.)
• Desirable experience in start-up or mid-scale growth environments.
• Desirable project management certifications (IPMA, CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, or any others)
• Friendly person with the patience and ability to build effective working relationships with people from very different backgrounds and groups.
• Experience on creating and maintaining relationships with partners and customers.
• Handling of multitasking activities with strong autonomous prioritization skills, without being overwhelmed for peaks of concurrent tasks.
• Highly detail-oriented person with a passion for being a proactive supplier of solutions.
• Strong work ethic and rigorous approach on managing confidential information.
• Fluency in local languages and working fluency in English is a must, basic German is nice to have but not required

jobs_results.title: Internship - Project Manager Life Science
jobs_results.description:
About the job

We are currently looking for an Intern to join state-of-the-art office in the heart of Madrid, combining in-person attendance with home-based remote work. This 12 month internship is an ideal opportunity for students with an interest to break into the Pharma and Biotech industry to learn about Technology and Data Science.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support project teams on delivering world-class results for some of the best-known organizations within the pharmaceutical industry, whilst receiving full training and support from experienced consultants.

You will develop your consulting and analytical skillset in supporting the design, development, and delivery of exciting consulting / market research projects. Assignments range in complexity from evaluating and scoping opportunities, research analysis, and problem solving, to translating data into meaningful insights and communicating recommendations to our clients.

We would love to meet you if you... are interested in developing a consulting mindset, be trained on data analysis, and support execution activities for complex healthcare data projects with technology.

OUR

Oracle Life Sciences is a global healthcare consulting firm and a trusted advisor to many of the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies. We are the world’s leading data, insights, and consulting company focused on healthcare.

We support our clients in marketing products that improve people’s lives and well-being. Our business is at the crossroads of consulting, data analytics, and real-world research, enabling clients to understand patients, physicians, and payers.

At Oracle Life Sciences we have an integrated way of rewarding our people based around a simple, clear, and consistent set of principles. Our approach helps to ensure we are competitive and supports a pay for performance culture, where your reward and career progression opportunities are linked to what you deliver.

SCOPE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Support internal team with project management tasks throughout all stages of engagements: identifying the client’s needs, defining the approach, performing analysis, working on drawing insights and conclusions, making strategic recommendations.
• Ensure timely communication and task completion with our partners and providers.
• Develop sophisticated communication skills, both bottom-up and top-down, to work with non- savvy senior clients and staff.
• Gain a deep knowledge of the healthcare industry.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
• Bachelor's degree in a field related to Life Sciences and an interest in Technology & Data Science, or in a field related to Technology or Data Science and an interest in Life Sciences
• Currently finishing a Bachelor or Master’s degree in either Life Sciences or Information technology or Data Science
• Fluency in English
• Drive to handle challenges, take initiative, and figure out solutions in a fast-paced environment
• Willingness to learn new things and be trained in a variety of topics during the internship
• C1 or equivalent ability to verbally communicate fluently and spontaneously, and write clear, well-structured, detailed text on complex subjects
• Excellent organizational skills and ability to multitask
• Positive team spirit, with strong interpersonal skills

DESIRED SKILLS
• Domain knowledge in Life Sciences, or Technology
• Python, Tableau, Power BI or related would be highly desireable
• Strong presentation and communication skills
• Passion for innovation, and the ability to influence and drive consensus with multiple stakeholders

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description: As the Salesforce project manager, you will oversee multiple Salesforce-based projects for our team, providing day-to-day leadership to analyse their requirements, develop designs, and implement cloud-based solutions based on Salesforce and force.com platforms. In this position, you will be working collaboratively with a highly motivated Salesforce team.

Key Skills Required:
• Salesforce project management background.
• Detail-oriented with the ability to quickly assimilate, a willingness to learn new technologies, a proactive entrepreneurial spirit, and reliability.
• Strong team player with exceptional writing and communication skills.
• Willingness to travel to meet with client on-site and for internal meetings.

Areas of Responsibility:
• Be enthusiastic, professional, and confident while maintaining a strong focus for the team.
• Manage the overall client relationship, have full command of the client business model, and demonstrate respect and responsiveness to... client needs.
• Act as primary day-to-day point of contact for the client and the operational aspects of the project.
• Focused on building strong customer relationships.
• Monitor and manage project financial, scope, and schedule to ensure project stays on track for assigned client projects.
• Drive implementations of high-quality cloud solutions.
• Monitor project status and assess risk in process, people, and/or technology and adjust project plans to address accordingly.
• Assist in consultant team members in the delivery of client presentations during requirements, design, pilot and user acceptance testing sessions.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team before sharing with the client.
• Leverage a solid understanding of the Salesforce product suite in order to validate key design options and present proposal solution designs and implementations.
• Cultivate and manage highly functional teams comprised of company and client resources through all phases of the software development lifecycle.
• Provide mentoring, guidance, and general care to project team members

jobs_results.title: Manufacturing & Supply Project manager
jobs_results.description:
A leading entity in the paints and coatings industry, renowned for its innovative products and commitment to sustainability, is seeking a Manufacturing & Supply Project Manager to join their team, based in Barcelona. This position plays a crucial role in managing the Make/Supply Planning transformation program within the Business Unit for Europe, driving the transition from current to newly designed planning processes, and developing regional planning team capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the transformation and continuous assessment of the supply chain to identify business improvement opportunities, including end-to-end value stream mapping.
• Analyze and define business improvements and projects to optimize supply chain performance in terms of On-Time In-Full (OTIF), Cost to Serve, and Working Capital across the EMEA Region.
• Develop customer service offers and translate them into replenishment models, optimizing the usage of the distribution network and enhancing... interactions between customer service and planning, including e-commerce strategies and logistics optimization.
• Support the delivery of regional supply chain KPIs and ensure collaborative partnerships with key stakeholders.
• Manage project scopes and timelines to ensure high-quality deliverables.

Qualifications:
• University degree with a minimum of 6 years of experience in the FMCG, Paint/Coating, or Retail industries, particularly in Supply Chain Improvement or Consulting.
• A strong consulting background with extensive experience in Manufacturing Supply Planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP) processes, and planning tools, including proficiency in SAP ECC and BI.
• Demonstrated ability in change management and stakeholder engagement, with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Resilient and adaptable with a problem-solving attitude and project management expertise.
• Fluency in English is mandatory.

The ideal candidate will be recognized for their credibility, openness to new ideas, result-oriented approach, and excellent problem-solving capabilities. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to significant business improvements and work within a diverse and inclusive environment committed to professional growth and development.

Are you interested? We would love to meet you!

Uno de nuestros objetivos como organización es asegurar un proceso de selección alineado con criterios de diversidad , equidad e inclusión por ello buscamos crear un panel de empleados diverso, equitativo e inclusivo, donde cada individuo sea valorado por su talento y potencial, sin importar su origen étnico, género, orientación sexual, religión o diversidad funcional.

Nos comprometemos a minimizar cualquier sesgo o barrera que pueda existir en el proceso de selección, para asegurar que todos los candidatos sean evaluados de manera justa y objetiva donde solo sea evaluado su capacidad para realizar la función, su potencial y su valores

jobs_results.title: Project Development Manager
jobs_results.description:
​The Green Recruitment Company is in the search of a Senior Project Manager to work in one of the most important IPPs in Europe with more than 15 GW of projects in development.

Responsibilities include:

​
• Technical project management in all stages of the project, from origination, to development, acquisition and financing, construction and operation.
• Lead end-to-end project development activities for Onshore Wind Greenfield projects, ensuring projects are delivered within scope, timeline, and budget.
• Conduct thorough feasibility studies, site assessments, and resource analyses to identify suitable project sites and assess their potential.
• Technically lead during due diligence for acquisition or divestiture of projects and financial closing processes, interacting with external technical advisors, sellers or buyers.
• Conducting regular reports on the technical progress of the project, providing detailed risk and opportunity analysis to the team and management.

​

The... requirements are the following:
• Plus 5years of experience leading the technical aspect of renewable energy Solar and BESS projects during development, design, acquisition, construction and operation in various markets, from the site identification stage, through the environmental evaluation until all permits and authorizations for the project are obtained.
• Possess interpersonal skills and results orientation to coordinate the work of stakeholders (technical advisors, consultants, project managers, proprietary engineers, investors, engineering and design offices of EPC companies, suppliers (investor, follower, modules, high voltage equipment ) for results orientation.
• Have an Engineering degree or equivalent.
• Fluent English and Spanish and Italian or French are highly valuable too

jobs_results.title: Project Manager, OBU Medical Affairs
jobs_results.description:
Location: Barcelona (on-site)

At AstraZeneca we work together across global boundaries to make an impact and find answers to challenges. We do this with the upmost integrity even in the most demanding situations because we are committed to doing the right thing. We put patients first and follow the science to bring life-changing medicines to patients that need them.

We are currently searching for a candidate who can drive strategic planning and execution of the OBU EUCAN projects and accountabilities for the OBU EUCAN Medical organization. The role would include project oversight and budget management, change implementation, and cross-functional coordination with multiple teams in and outside of OBU Medical. This role would report directly to the Medical Innovation, Strategy & Operations Leader for OBU Medical but would partner closely with the VP & Head of EUCAN Medical Affairs and EUCAN Portfolio Director. The position will be based in Barcelona, Spain.

The ideal candidate will... be expected to work in a highly effective way with other project managers and leaders to implement global and regional strategies at all levels through the interconnected organisation. The ideal candidate can demonstrate their strategic thinking, problem solving skills, ability to work collaboratively and act decisively to support the broader goals of OBU Medical as a whole.

Accountabilities/responsibilities

Leadership Team:
• Partners with VP EUCAN and EUCAN Portfolio Director to implement goals, projects, budgets, schedules, and drive performance for the organization, and monitors progress and mitigates risks for delivery of responsible projects.
• Facilitates LT meetings including Regional Therapy Area Leader network forums, providing strategic input into meeting agendas, and manage action items from those meetings.
• Manage, partner with and coordinate multiple stakeholders (Global, Regional & Local), to ensure alignment of cross-Franchise and cross-Functional commitment to strategic objectives and support with initiatives (e.g. evidence generation, Portfolio prioritisation, Launch excellence etc.).
• Responsible for pull-through and implementation of key functional team deliverables such as scorecards, value metrics, department forums, walking decks, leadership presentations, etc.
• Responsible for oversight of and communicating status of responsible project budget, phasing and prioritization across the business planning cycle as well as rollup into Long Range Plans.

Project Management Team
• Partners closely with the Global Project Management Office to drive operational efficiency and excellence, streamline processes and methodologies, and identify continuous improvement and simplification, to optimise bi-directional Global-Region-Local communication and implementation.

Culture
• Encourage a vibrant, entrepreneurial and externally facing team focused on the delivery of successful projects and programs that support courageous leadership, innovation and collaboration.
• Collaborate strongly with other Project Leaders to embed standard methodology.

jobs_results.title: Manufacturing/Supply Chain Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
About AkzoNobel

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2024 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

Job Purpose
• Manage Make/Supply Planning transformation program in the BU for Europe.
• Plan and drive activities to move from current planning procedures to the newly designed planning processes.
•... Develop region planning team capabilities
• Anticipate transformation risks and issues, propose mitigation actions and escalate when appropriate.
• Ensure a good communication and integration with demand/Bus, manufacturing, procurement, logistics and finance

Key Accountabilities
• Work on the transformation & continuous supply chain assessment & benchmarking to identify business improvement opportunities, including end to end value stream mapping.
• Analyze and define business improvements and projects to optimize end to end supply chain performance in OTIF, Cost to serve and working capital (inventory, payables, receivables) for the EMEA Region
• Customer service offer preparation and the translation into replenishment models
• Examples: optimize usage of distribution network and interaction between customer service and planning, e-commerce, route to market, lot sizes, truck rates
• Support delivering regional supply chain KPIs
• Secure and develop a collaborative partnership with key stakeholder
• Manage project scope, timelines, bring good deliverables

Education & Experience
• University Education with at least 6 years’ experience in FMCG, Paint/Coating or Retail industries Supply Chain Improvement or consulting
• Consulting background (4+ years of experience)
• High level of experience on Manufacturing, Supply Planning, IBP processes, Planning tools, Supply planning, planning in SAP ECC and BI
• Change management: ability to manage a diverse range of stakeholders
• Excellent interpersonal relationship skills and communicator, able to listen, able to handle team tensions
• Stress resistance, flexible, problem solving attitude
• Project Management skills
• Seen by others as credible, trustworthy, and open to new ideas
• Focused on results
• Good problem-solving skills, able to identify and structure issues, run accurate analyses and synthesize recommendations
• Fluent in English

At AkzoNobel we are highly committed to ensuring an inclusive and respectful workplace where all employees can be their best self. We strive to embrace diversity in a context of tolerance. Our talent acquisition process plays an integral part in this journey, as setting the foundations for a diverse environment. For this reason we train and educate on the implications of our Unconscious Bias in order for our TA and hiring managers to be mindful of them and take corrective actions when applicable. In our organization, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

Requisition ID: 38788

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager, Art Creative Services 2D + 3D
jobs_results.description:
Scopely is looking for a highly motivated Senior Project Manager to join our Marketing team Flamed in Barcelona Office on a Hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

We are the in-house creative agency, Flamed, an International multidisciplinary team. We build thousands of creatives every year to support all Scopely games Marketing needs worldwide. You will work on the leading mobile casual "Monopoly Go", mid-core games like Star Trek Fleet Command and Stumble Guys, among others.

What You Will Do
In this role, you will handle a dynamic creative team in Barcelona and several external creative agencies in the US and EU. You’ll oversee the... daily tracking of each creative project, ensuring that creative team utilization, budgets, and creative quality goals are met or exceeded. Organization, foresight and attention to detail is a requirement; the PM should be highly organized, a strong communicator, and process driven. Work closely with the Strategy and RPG Team and the rest of the team to deliver a high number of projects per month in a timely and effective manner.
• Work closely with the Art Director and the rest of the team to deliver a high number of projects per month in a timely and effective manner and reporting to the Producer Manager
• Lead the management of your game/s asset development with internal and external teams, including Design, 3D assets, statics, and Re-sizing projects.
• Direct the creative team on these efforts, organize their queues and handle asset delivery to the asset management tool.
• Effectively balance multiple high-priority assignments and allocations for the creative department across both internal and external teams.
• Provide regular feedback to the marketing and creative teams on priorities and deadlines.
• Collaborate with internal product teams and external development teams on game assets.
• Assist the internal review and approvals process.
• Demonstrate clear ownership and accountability, delivering creative assets on time, within budget, to a high level of quality
• Communicate clearly between the team to guarantee alignment on expectations, lead asset changes efficiently and is able to prioritize P
• Pro-actively sets and leads meetings with internal and external collaborators to communicate on projects, status, issues or changes maintaining the teams' aligned

What We’re Looking For
• 6+ years of Project and Creative Management with a strong experience in advertising, creative services or production.
• Experience working closely with creative teams and creative projects
• Strong organization skills and attention to detail
• Passionate, committed and humble
• Experience with Digital assets and asset management
• Excellent communication skills in English
• Spanish is a plus
• Video games or Mobile games experience is a plus
• Creative pipeline knowledge is a plus
Hybrid, based 1-2 days a week in Scoplely's offices in Barcelona, with 4/5 days work from home/remotely.
Please include a portfolio or PDF/links to examples of your work in the application.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Us
Scopely is a global interactive entertainment and mobile-first video game company, home to many top, award-winning experiences such as "MONOPOLY GO!," “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “Stumble Guys,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” and “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” among others.
Scopely creates, publishes, and live-operates immersive games that empower a directed-by-consumer™ experience across multiple platforms—from mobile, web, PC and beyond.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is fueled by a world-class team and a proprietary technology platform Playgami that supports one of the most diversified portfolios in the games industry.
Recognized multiple times as one of Fast Company’s “World’s Most Innovative Companies,” Scopely is a multi-billion-dollar business due to its ability to create long-lasting game experiences that players enjoy for years.
Scopely has global operations in more than a dozen markets across Asia, EMEA, and North America, and is home to many internal game development teams, referred to as Scopely Studios, with additional game studio partners across four continents.
Scopely was acquired by Savvy Games Group in July 2023 for $4.9 billion, and is now an independent subsidiary of Savvy.

For more information on Scopely, visit: scopely.com

Notice to candidates: Scopely, Inc and its affiliates will never request payment or ask for financial information as a condition for applying to a position or receiving an offer of employment.All official Scopely, Inc. recruiters only use email domains that end with @scopely.com.

Our official website is www.scopely.com. Please only apply to positions posted on our official website and ensure the recruiter only communicates via the official email domain.
